name: Lesson 2: Answering vocabulary questions and inferring the meaning
descriptionHtml:
Vocabulary, Main idea and Inference questions are three other types of questions that are often asked in the TOEIC part 7. Here, we provide some tips to effectively deal with them. 

1. Question type

You have to read different passages and then answer vocabulary, main idea and inference questions related to these passages. 

 

2. Guide to answer

- With vocabulary questions, read the sentences around the target word to try to guess the meaning. The vocabulary questions sometimes use challenging vocabulary. If you don't know all of the words, ignore the ones you do know that don’t answer the question. This will increase your chances of a successful guess.

- With main idea questions, you should skim the passage to confirm the most likely answer choice. In addition, you can answer specific and vocabulary questions first to help you answer main idea questions more correctly. 

- With inference questions, look for words or ideas in the passage related to the things noted in each answer choice.
